import re

CONTROLLER = re.compile(r"^(?P<controller>\S.*?) in Slot (?P<slot>\d+)(?:\s+\((?P<type>[^)]*)\))?\s+\(sn: (?P<serial>[^)]*)\)\s*$")
CAGE = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<cage>\S.*? Drive Cage) at Port (?P<port>\S+), Box (?P<box>\d+), (?P<status>\S.*?)\s*$")
PORT = re.compile(r"^\s+Port Name: (?P<port>\S+)\s*$")
ARRAY = re.compile(r"^\s+Array (?P<array>\S+) \((?P<type>[^,]+), Unused Space: (?P<unused>[^)]*?)\s*\)\s*$")
UNASSIGNED = re.compile(r"^\s+Unassigned\s*$")
LOGICAL = re.compile(r"^\s+logicaldrive (?P<id>\d+) \((?P<size>[^,]+), (?P<raid>RAID [^,]+), (?P<status>[^)]*)\)\s*$")
PHYSICAL = re.compile(r"^\s+physicaldrive (?P<id>\S+) \(port (?P<port>[^:]+):box (?P<box>\d+):bay (?P<bay>\d+), (?P<type>[^,]+), (?P<size>[^,]+), (?P<status>[^,)]+)(?:, (?P<role>[^)]*))?\)\s*$")
SEP = re.compile(r"^\s+SEP \(Vendor ID (?P<vendor>[^,]+), Model (?P<model>[^)]+)\)\s+(?P<id>\d+)\s+\(WWID: (?P<wwid>\w+)\)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    def block(name):
        return {"name": name, "kind": "table", "lines": [], "records": []}
    controllers, cages, ports, arrays = block("controllers"), block("drive_cages"), block("ports"), block("arrays")
    logical, physical, seps, other = block("logical_drives"), block("physical_drives"), block("sep"), block("other")
    ctl = slot = array = ""
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = CONTROLLER.match(ln)
        if m:
            ctl, slot, array = m.group("controller"), m.group("slot"), ""
            controllers["lines"].append(i)
            controllers["records"].append({"Controller": ctl, "Slot": slot, "Type": m.group("type") or "",
                                           "Serial": m.group("serial")})
            continue
        owner = {"Controller": ctl, "Slot": slot}
        m = CAGE.match(ln)
        if m:
            cages["lines"].append(i)
            cages["records"].append(dict(owner, Cage=m.group("cage"), Port=m.group("port"), Box=m.group("box"),
                                         Status=m.group("status")))
            continue
        m = PORT.match(ln)
        if m:
            ports["lines"].append(i)
            ports["records"].append(dict(owner, **{"Port Name": m.group("port")}))
            continue
        m = ARRAY.match(ln)
        if m:
            array = m.group("array")
            arrays["lines"].append(i)
            arrays["records"].append(dict(owner, Array=array, Type=m.group("type"),
                                          **{"Unused Space": m.group("unused")}))
            continue
        if UNASSIGNED.match(ln):
            array = "Unassigned"
            physical["lines"].append(i)
            continue
        m = LOGICAL.match(ln)
        if m:
            logical["lines"].append(i)
            logical["records"].append(dict(owner, Array=array, logicaldrive=m.group("id"), Size=m.group("size"),
                                           RAID=m.group("raid"), Status=m.group("status")))
            continue
        m = PHYSICAL.match(ln)
        if m:
            physical["lines"].append(i)
            physical["records"].append(dict(owner, Array=array, physicaldrive=m.group("id"), Port=m.group("port"),
                                            Box=m.group("box"), Bay=m.group("bay"), Type=m.group("type"),
                                            Size=m.group("size"), Status=m.group("status"),
                                            Role=m.group("role") or ""))
            continue
        m = SEP.match(ln)
        if m:
            seps["lines"].append(i)
            seps["records"].append(dict(owner, **{"Vendor ID": m.group("vendor"), "Model": m.group("model"),
                                                  "SEP": m.group("id"), "WWID": m.group("wwid")}))
            continue
        other["lines"].append(i)
        other["records"].append(dict(owner, Array=array, Line=ln.strip()))
    return [controllers, cages, ports, arrays, logical, physical, seps, other]
